description: A brand's products whose prices dropped recently (up to the last 7 days) across Indian online stores, biggest drop first. Use for 'Samsung price drops', 'what Philips products got cheaper', 'any deals on boAt this week', 'Samsung TV price drops' (brand + keyword). Pass the brand name as written by the user; optional keyword narrows to a product type (e.g. 'tv', 'washing machine'). Each product's priceChange is the drop in INR (negative). Shown to the user as product cards.

keyword.description: Optional product type within the brand, e.g. 'tv', 'refrigerator', 'air fryer'

name: brand_price_drops

atLowestPrice.description: True when the current price is the lowest ever recorded

id.description: CheapestInIndia product id — pass through unchanged

lowestPrice.description: Lowest price ever recorded by CheapestInIndia, INR

mrp.description: Maximum retail price in INR, when known

priceChange.description: Most recent price change in INR (negative = price dropped, positive = went up)

productPageUrl.description: CheapestInIndia price-history page — use for citations

productUrl.description: Attributed buy link (CheapestInIndia redirect to the retailer)

searchPageUrl.description: The brand's price-drop page on CheapestInIndia

title: Brand price drops
